name: Level21_FirstSwitch
hint: Enter the diamond pad to toggle its matching gate.

name: Level22_OpenForRed
hint: Yellow can open the route for Red.

name: Level23_ToggleTwice
hint: Two entries toggle twice. Prepare the open gate before Red enters its pad.

name: Level24_ClosedLane
hint: Closed gates block movement. Activate Yellow first.

name: Level25_BeforeYouGo
hint: Plan the gate state before spending moves along the lane.

name: Level26_ThreeEntries
hint: Every entry toggles. Three pad entries leave the gate open.

name: Level27_BoxDoesNotPress
hint: Boxes do not press pads. Push it aside, then let Yellow enter.

name: Level28_TurnThrough
hint: Open the gate before the arrow sends Red through it.

name: Level29_ClockworkGate
hint: The rotator still turns clockwise. The pad prepares its landing.

name: Level30_ClearThenOpen
hint: Blue prepares the lower alcove. Red finishes around the high corner.

name: Level31_OnePadTwoGates
hint: One diamond pad toggles both matching gates.

name: Level32_OppositeStates
hint: Finish the upper room before the lower pad reverses all four gates.

name: Level33_SharedDeliveryGate
hint: Open both gates, then push both Reds down the shared lane.

name: Level34_ClearTheCorridor
hint: Blue yields the junction and opens the east passage. Red takes the corner.

name: Level35_TwoChannels
hint: Two isolated staging pads prepare the narrow delivery lane.

name: Level36_CrossBeforeClosing
hint: Open Blue's approach, cross before reversing it, then reach the second channel.

name: Level37_OpenTheSecondPad
hint: One diamond opens the way to the two-diamond pad.

name: Level38_LiftAndTurn
hint: Clear the box parking space. Prepare the gate, then release the final cascade.

name: Level39_PrepareToggleRedirect
hint: Both Reds share the throat. Can one help deliver the other?

name: Level40_TheStateOfShift
hint: Clear Blue, park the box east, then join the two rooms. The tempting upward push changes the plan.
